attrs.why_open: Deciding f_c(∅) = 0 requires running the successor model on the capability with every artifact ablated, and this artifact runs no model. The one instance it asserts — that current frontier models compute XOR unaided — is declared from general knowledge and is not an observation made here. EMB-CUT-EMPTY is unaffected: it is an implication about every monotone f with f(∅)=1, and does not assert that any particular capability has that property.
